description: Among 120 farmworkers hand-harvesting sweet potatoes in eastern North Carolina, 79% reported any pain or discomfort; the back was highest at 66%, shoulders 31%. Working more than five years as a farmworker was significantly associated with back pain.
energy_note: Two in three, in the back.

aspect: EXAMPLE - precarity predicts back pain, independently
description: In a study of 189 farmworkers and non-farmworkers in North Carolina, job precariousness was associated with back pain at an odds ratio of 2.09 (95% CI 1.01-4.23), and depressive symptoms were significantly associated with neck and shoulder pain.
energy_note: Insecure work doubles the back pain, on its own.
notes: This is the row that answers the brief's 'efficiency, growth, back pain' question most directly. Compare SOM-002 in assets/text/nigeria, which found the same shape in a different population.

aspect: EXAMPLE - non-farm manual work is worse, not better
description: Physician examinations of 272 workers found musculoskeletal disorders in 49% of non-farmworkers against 35% of farmworkers, with epicondylitis 20.2% and rotator cuff syndrome 19.1%. Overall prevalence was high compared with other workers in similar occupations.
energy_note: Leaving the fields does not save the body.

aspect: EXAMPLE - and it feeds straight back into output
description: A Texas study of 228 workers across 28 small construction firms found musculoskeletal pain and sleep hours significantly affected productivity, with more pain sites producing more severe productivity loss, worst among those sleeping under six hours.
energy_note: The pain, then the output, then the earnings.

aspect: Treated late, because treatment costs a day
description: Pain is worked through until it is disabling, because a clinic visit costs a shift and possibly the job - so the presentation is chronic by the time it is seen.
energy_note: Seen by a doctor years after it started.

aspect: The body is the asset and it is depreciating
description: Where earning depends on lifting, the working life is finite and the end of it arrives around fifty with no pension attached - ECO-001's informality means no contributions were made.
energy_note: The asset wears out at fifty and there is no pension.

aspect: He teaches his son the same trade
description: Without the credential route (PSY-005), the transmissible asset is the trade itself, so the occupational exposure is inherited along with the livelihood.
energy_note: Passing on the work and the back pain together.
